title: Implement autonomous deliverable composer
whyNeeded: Current autonomous run persists campaign and agent metadata but does not guarantee complete campaign item deliverables.
acceptanceCriteria: Each autonomous run writes campaign items for strategy/copy/script/scene/media/QA/export components.
Each item contains review status and source metadata.
UI can render package without parsing agent logs.

title: Create one-click image ad generation flow
whyNeeded: Core user journey cannot be considered live-ready without deterministic image-ad output path.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt -> image job -> playable asset -> preview card -> review item.
setup_needed shown only when route/config is missing.
No completed state without playable image asset.

title: Create one-click 30-second ad package flow
whyNeeded: Main commercial outcome requires full ad package, not only script or planning metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Outputs include strategy, hooks, copy, CTA, script, scene plan, media requirements, captions, QA and schedule draft.
Package persists as campaign items and appears in UI.
Blocked steps are explicit and do not fake completion.

title: Harden media asset invariants in persistence layer
whyNeeded: Status/url/mime drift is still possible if upstream calls misuse updateMediaAsset.
acceptanceCriteria: Asset cannot be persisted as completed unless playable URL/path + valid MIME are present.
Invalid completed patches are rejected or auto-demoted to failed.
Tests cover all invalid combinations.

title: Simplify settings into guided setup wizard
whyNeeded: Current diagnostics are accurate but too technical for operators trying to go live quickly.
dependencies: Backend readiness and connector readiness endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Wizard lists exact next action per provider/connector/dependency.
Secrets remain masked.
Raw diagnostics are optional advanced mode only.

title: Add end-to-end smoke tests for production journeys
whyNeeded: Current suite validates contracts well but not complete user-facing deliverables.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover image ad, 30-second ad package, full campaign package and export draft generation.
Tests verify no fake completed media or posted states.

title: Unify modern creation path and deprecate legacy compatibility endpoints
whyNeeded: Legacy-compatible routes increase ambiguity and maintenance overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary UI uses one canonical create flow.
Legacy endpoints are isolated from product UX and clearly marked internal/deprecated.

title: Strengthen campaign package rendering in frontend
whyNeeded: Users need direct deliverable cards, not agent/task log interpretation.
acceptanceCriteria: UI renders package sections: strategy/hook/copy/script/scenes/assets/QA/review/export.
Each section shows complete/blocked/setup_needed truth states.

title: Improve connector adapter implementations (real posting)
whyNeeded: Export-first is safe but live posting requires complete token/scope/API integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Each platform adapter validates payload and connection, and returns real post/upload IDs on success.
No adapter returns fake success IDs.

title: Finalize 60-second assembled video production pipeline
whyNeeded: Product promise includes full short-video production, not only planning scaffolds.
acceptanceCriteria: Scene plan maps to timeline slots with asset fill and audio/caption overlays.
Render completes only with output asset present.
UI exposes deterministic progress and blockers.
